038/**
039 * Creates and runs a supervisor-led team with two worker agent-task pairs.
040 *
041 * <p>{@link AgentAttributes.Builder#supervisor(Boolean) supervisor(true)}
042 * designates an agent as a supervisor at creation time. The team assigns that
043 * same agent through {@link TeamAttributes.Builder#supervisorAgent(String)}.
044 * Its {@code agents} list contains only workers, not the supervisor. With
045 * {@code process("sequential")}, the supervisor delegates one worker subtask
046 * at a time. Worker-specific instructions belong to the worker tasks.</p>
047 *
048 * <p>The sample creates one SQL tool, two tasks, two worker agents, a supervisor
049 * agent, a team, and a database conversation. The default prompt supplies
050 * synthetic revenue and expense figures; no sales tables or SH schema are
051 * required. The profile must already exist, support the SQL tool, and be
052 * accessible to the configured database user. The database must support
053 * supervisor-led teams. Execution can invoke an external model and incur
054 * provider charges. Generated responses are printed for demonstration only.</p>
055 *
056 * <p>Every successfully created resource is dropped in reverse dependency
057 * order, including after a failure. Existing profiles and credentials are not
058 * modified or deleted. Cleanup failures are propagated, or suppressed on an
059 * existing execution failure, so failed execution or cleanup produces a
060 * nonzero process exit status.</p>
061 *
062 * <p>Required environment variables: {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER},
063 * {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD}, {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, and
064 * {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME}.</p>
065 *
066 * <p>Optional variables: {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_SUPERVISOR_PREFIX} overrides the
067 * unique resource-name prefix; {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_SUPERVISOR_PROMPT}
068 * overrides the synthetic analysis request. Use a prefix that does not name
069 * existing resources. The supervisor flag cannot be changed after creation.</p>
070 *
071 * <p>Build and run from the repository root:</p>
072 * <pre>{@code
073 * mvn clean install
074 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime \
075 *     -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
076 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.1.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
077 *     -d samples/out \
078 *     samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SupervisorTeamSample.java
079 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.1.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
080 *     com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent.SupervisorTeamSample
081 * }</pre>
082 *
083 * @see CreateAgentSample
084 * @see CreateTeamSample
085 * @see AgentWorkflowSample
086 */
087public final class SupervisorTeamSample {
088    private SupervisorTeamSample() {
089    }
090
091    /**
092     * Creates the supervised workflow, runs it, and cleans up its resources.
093     *
094     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
095     * @throws SelectAIException when execution, cleanup, or client closure fails
096     */
097    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
098        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
099        String prefix = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_SUPERVISOR_PREFIX", generatedPrefix());
100        String prompt = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_SUPERVISOR_PROMPT",
101                "Using these synthetic figures, calculate the quarter-over-quarter revenue change "
102                        + "and the change in profit margin. Q1 revenue is 100000 and expenses are 60000; "
103                        + "Q2 revenue is 80000 and expenses are 60000. Summarize what we should investigate.");
104        DbConnectionConfig config = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
105                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
106                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
107                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
108                .build();
109
110        try (SelectAIAgent agentClient = SelectAIAgent.create(config);
111             SelectAI selectAI = SelectAI.create(config)) {
112            run(agentClient, selectAI, profileName, prefix, prompt);
113        }
114    }
115
116    /** Runs with caller-owned clients; cleanup covers only resources created here. */
117    static void run(SelectAIAgent agentClient, SelectAI selectAI, String profileName,
118                    String prefix, String prompt) throws SelectAIException {
119        String toolName = prefix + "_SQL";
120        String revenueTaskName = prefix + "_REV_TASK";
121        String marginTaskName = prefix + "_MARGIN_TASK";
122        String revenueAgentName = prefix + "_REV_AGENT";
123        String marginAgentName = prefix + "_MARGIN_AGENT";
124        String supervisorName = prefix + "_SUPERVISOR";
125        String teamName = prefix + "_TEAM";
126        System.out.printf("Supervisor team: %s; supervisor agent: %s%n", teamName, supervisorName);
127
128        try (Cleanup cleanup = new Cleanup()) {
129            Tool tool = agentClient.tool(toolName,
130                    ToolAttributes.builder()
131                            .toolType(ToolType.SQL)
132                            .toolParams(SqlToolParams.builder().profileName(profileName).build())
133                            .build(),
134                    "SQL calculation tool created by SupervisorTeamSample.", ToolStatus.ENABLED);
135            if (tool.create()) {
136                cleanup.add("tool", toolName, () -> tool.drop(false));
137            }
138
139            Task revenueTask = agentClient.task(revenueTaskName,
140                    TaskAttributes.builder()
141                            .instruction("Calculate the quarter-over-quarter revenue change and percentage "
142                                    + "from the supplied figures: {query}. Use the SQL tool with RUNSQL "
143                                    + "and arithmetic SELECT expressions over DUAL; do not query sales tables.")
144                            .tools(List.of(toolName))
145                            .enableHumanTool(false)
146                            .build(),
147                    "Revenue analysis task created by SupervisorTeamSample.", TaskStatus.ENABLED);
148            if (revenueTask.create()) {
149                cleanup.add("task", revenueTaskName, () -> revenueTask.drop(false));
150            }
151
152            Task marginTask = agentClient.task(marginTaskName,
153                    TaskAttributes.builder()
154                            .instruction("Calculate profit and profit margin for each quarter from the supplied "
155                                    + "figures: {query}. Explain the margin change. Use the SQL tool with RUNSQL "
156                                    + "and arithmetic SELECT expressions over DUAL; do not query sales tables.")
157                            .tools(List.of(toolName))
158                            .enableHumanTool(false)
159                            .build(),
160                    "Margin analysis task created by SupervisorTeamSample.", TaskStatus.ENABLED);
161            if (marginTask.create()) {
162                cleanup.add("task", marginTaskName, () -> marginTask.drop(false));
163            }
164
165            Agent revenueAgent = agentClient.agent(revenueAgentName,
166                    AgentAttributes.builder()
167                            .profileName(profileName)
168                            .role("Analyze revenue changes using only the figures supplied in the request.")
169                            .supervisor(false)
170                            .enableHumanTool(false)
171                            .build(),
172                    "Revenue worker created by SupervisorTeamSample.", AgentStatus.ENABLED);
173            if (revenueAgent.create()) {
174                cleanup.add("agent", revenueAgentName, () -> revenueAgent.drop(false));
175            }
176
177            Agent marginAgent = agentClient.agent(marginAgentName,
178                    AgentAttributes.builder()
179                            .profileName(profileName)
180                            .role("Analyze profit margins using only the figures supplied in the request.")
181                            .supervisor(false)
182                            .enableHumanTool(false)
183                            .build(),
184                    "Margin worker created by SupervisorTeamSample.", AgentStatus.ENABLED);
185            if (marginAgent.create()) {
186                cleanup.add("agent", marginAgentName, () -> marginAgent.drop(false));
187            }
188
189            // This flag designates the agent as a supervisor; it does not assign a team.
190            Agent supervisor = agentClient.agent(supervisorName,
191                    AgentAttributes.builder()
192                            .profileName(profileName)
193                            .role("Delegate revenue analysis to " + revenueAgentName
194                                    + " and margin analysis to " + marginAgentName
195                                    + ". Pass the supplied figures to each worker. Combine their results "
196                                    + "and suggest follow-up questions without inventing business facts.")
197                            .supervisor(true)
198                            .enableHumanTool(false)
199                            .build(),
200                    "Supervisor created by SupervisorTeamSample.", AgentStatus.ENABLED);
201            if (supervisor.create()) {
202                cleanup.add("agent", supervisorName, () -> supervisor.drop(false));
203            }
204
205            // Assign the supervisor separately; only worker-task pairs belong in agents.
206            Team team = agentClient.team(teamName,
207                    TeamAttributes.builder()
208                            .supervisorAgent(supervisor.getAgentName())
209                            .process("sequential")
210                            .agents(List.of(
211                                    TeamMember.builder(revenueAgentName).task(revenueTaskName).build(),
212                                    TeamMember.builder(marginAgentName).task(marginTaskName).build()))
213                            .build(),
214                    "Supervisor-led team created by SupervisorTeamSample.", TeamStatus.ENABLED);
215            if (team.create()) {
216                cleanup.add("team", teamName, () -> team.drop(false));
217            }
218
219            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(ConversationAttributes.builder()
220                    .title("SupervisorTeamSample conversation")
221                    .build());
222            String conversationId = conversation.create();
223            cleanup.add("conversation", conversationId, () -> conversation.drop(false));
224
225            String response = team.run(RunTeamRequest.builder()
226                    .userPrompt(prompt)
227                    .conversationId(conversationId)
228                    .build()).getRawValue();
229            System.out.printf("Supervisor team response: %s%n", response);
230        }
231        System.out.println("Supervisor workflow cleanup completed.");
232    }
233
234    /** Attempts every registered drop and preserves failures for the caller. */
235    private static final class Cleanup implements AutoCloseable {
236        /** Successfully created resources, most recent first. */
237        private final Deque<CleanupAction> actions = new ArrayDeque<>();
238
239        private void add(String resourceType, String name, DropOperation operation) {
240            actions.push(new CleanupAction(resourceType, name, operation));
241        }
242
243        @Override
244        public void close() throws SelectAIException {
245            SelectAIException failure = null;
246            while (!actions.isEmpty()) {
247                CleanupAction action = actions.pop();
248                try {
249                    action.operation().drop();
250                } catch (Exception e) {
251                    SelectAIException cleanupFailure = new SelectAIException(
252                            "Failed to drop " + action.resourceType() + " '" + action.name()
253                                    + "' created by SupervisorTeamSample", e);
254                    if (failure == null) {
255                        failure = cleanupFailure;
256                    } else {
257                        failure.addSuppressed(cleanupFailure);
258                    }
259                }
260            }
261            if (failure != null) {
262                throw failure;
263            }
264        }
265    }
266
267    /** One resource created successfully by this sample. */
268    private record CleanupAction(String resourceType, String name, DropOperation operation) { }
269
270    /** Drop operation registered only after successful creation. */
271    @FunctionalInterface
272    private interface DropOperation {
273        void drop() throws SelectAIException;
274    }
275
276    private static String generatedPrefix() {
277        return "JSAISUP_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "")
278                .substring(0, 8).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
279    }
280
281    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
282        String value = System.getenv(name);
283        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
284            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
285        }
286        return value;
287    }
288
289    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
290        String value = System.getenv(name);
291        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
292    }
293}
